svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Lung cancer death rate in men vs. women 2023
The reported annual death rate from lung cancer per 100,000 people in men versus women, based on the
underlying cause listed on death certificates.

tspan.tspan: To allow for comparisons between countries and over time, the metrics are age-standardized. All deaths in a country may not have been

text.tspan: registered with a cause of death. Where data for 2023 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2018 and 2022 is shown
